Gamma-Gamma exponent in the progress report
note: The report's Fig. 2 (peak 0.71 then decay to ~0.08 at Rytov variance 10) is reproduced only when sigma_R^(12/5) is evaluated as (Rytov variance)^(12/5). In the Andrews-Phillips formulas sigma_R is the Rytov STANDARD DEVIATION, i.e. the exponent is 6/5 on the variance; with it the scintillation index peaks at ~1.2-1.3 near variance 5-10 and saturates toward 1 (aperture-averaged curve scales down accordingly). The same slip was present in the repository's Gamma-Gamma code until v2.2.0. The cumulant formulas themselves are unaffected and are tested below under BOTH conventions.
